findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: zambo_universal, provibe_audit, ghost_audit_site, prompt_shield · Private data: zambo_universal, leadsignal · Public sink: zambo_universal, provibe_audit, prompt_shield · Destructive: zambo_universal, ghost_audit_site.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: zambo_universal, provibe_audit, ghost_audit_site, prompt_shield · Private data: zambo_universal, leadsignal · Public sink: zambo_universal, provibe_audit, prompt_shield · Destructive: zambo_universal, ghost_audit_site

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
